CHR_CITYNAME CITY , f.CHR_DISTRICT DISTRICT,  e.CHR_STATENAME STATENAME,    e.CHR_TINCODE STATECODE, b.INT_PINCODE PINCODE,  a.DOU_TOTALAMOUNT INVOICEVALUE,   FUN_INV_PRODUCTCODE(c.CHR_TYPE,c.CHR_ITEMID) ITEMNAME, FUN_INV_HSNCODE(c.CHR_TYPE,c.CHR_ITEMID) HSNCODE,   ROUND(c.DOU_TAX_PERCENTAGE,0) GSTRATE, 	c.INT_QUANTITY QTY, 	FUN_INV_UNITS(c.CHR_TYPE,c.CHR_ITEMID) UOM,  	DOU_UNITPRICE RATE,   c.DOU_UNITDISCOUNT DISCOUNT, 	((c.INT_QUANTITY*c.DOU_UNITPRICE) - c.DOU_UNITDISCOUNT) AMOUNT,   CONCAT('GST Purchase A/c')	SALESLEDGERNAME,   IF(a.CHR_GST_TYPE !='S', ROUND(d.CHR_PERCENTAGE,2) , '') IGST, IF(a.CHR_GST_TYPE !='S', FUN_INV_DIRECT_PURCHASE_TAX_AMOUNT(a.CHR_PURCHASEORDERNO , 'igst'),'') IGSTAMOUNT,   IF(a.CHR_GST_TYPE ='S', ROUND((d.CHR_PERCENTAGE * DOU_CGST/100)  , ''),2) CGST,   IF(a.CHR_GST_TYPE ='S',  FUN_INV_DIRECT_PURCHASE_TAX_AMOUNT(a.CHR_PURCHASEORDERNO , 'cgst'),'') CGSTAMOUNT,  IF(a.CHR_GST_TYPE ='S', ROUND((d.CHR_PERCENTAGE * DOU_SGST/100)  , '') ,2) SGST,   IF(a.CHR_GST_TYPE ='S', FUN_INV_DIRECT_PURCHASE_TAX_AMOUNT(a.CHR_PURCHASEORDERNO , 'sgst'), '' ) SGSTAMOUNT,  CONCAT('') TCS, CONCAT('') TCSAMOUNT,  IF(a.DOU_TAXAMOUNT >0 , a.INT_TAXID , '') TDS, a.DOU_TAXAMOUNT TDSAMOUNT,   a.DOU_FRIEGHT_CHARGE  FREIGHTCHARGE,  CONCAT('') ADD_OR_LESS1, CONCAT('') ADD_OR_LESS, CONCAT('') ADD_OR_LESS,    a.DOU_ROUNDED ROUNDOFF, a.DOU_TOTALAMOUNT INVOICEVALUE_2,  CONCAT('CORPORATE') COSTCAT,  REPLACE(RIGHT(a.CHR_PURCHASEORDERNO,7),'/','-') COSTCENTER, REPLACE(LEFT(a.CHR_DES,200),'
','') NARRATION,  SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 1, 50) PROD_DEC1 , SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 51, 50) PROD_DEC2 , SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 101, 50) PROD_DEC3 , SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 151, 50) PROD_DEC4 ,   SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 200, 50) PROD_DEC5 , SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 201, 50) PROD_DEC6 , SUBSTRING(c.CHR_DESC, 251, 50) PROD_DEC7 ,   CONCAT('') SRNO_DETAILS,   FUN_INV_GET_WARRANTY_IN_YEAR(c.INT_WARRANTY) WARRANTY_DETAILS,  CONCAT('') PO_REFERENCE, FIND_A_PAYMENT_TERM(a.INT_PAYMENTTERMID) PAYMENT_TERMS, CONCAT('') DESPATCHED_THRU, CONCAT('') DESTINATION,  CONCAT('') CONTACT_PERSON, CONCAT('') CONTACT_NO,  b.CHR_VENDORNAME CONSIGNEE_NAME, b.CHR_ADDRESS1 CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS1, b.CHR_ADDRESS2 CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS2,    CONCAT('') CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS3,  g.
